scripts.build: npm run build:html && npm run build:css && npm run copy:assets && npm run copy:js
scripts.build:html: posthtml src/index.html -o dist/index.html -c posthtml.config.cjs && posthtml src/work-and-ethic.html -o dist/work-and-ethic.html -c posthtml.config.cjs && posthtml src/the-giants.html -o dist/the-giants.html -c posthtml.config.cjs
scripts.dev: npm run copy:js && npm run build:html && concurrently -k -n html,css,assets,js,serve "npm run dev:html" "npm run dev:css" "npm run dev:assets" "npm run dev:js" "npm run dev:serve"
scripts.dev:html: onchange -i "src/**/*.html" "src/**/*.svg" -- sh -c 'posthtml src/index.html -o dist/index.html -c posthtml.config.cjs && posthtml src/work-and-ethic.html -o dist/work-and-ethic.html -c posthtml.config.cjs && posthtml src/the-giants.html -o dist/the-giants.html -c posthtml.config.cjs'
